name: Sprint Precision Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Sprint Precision Technologies Co., Ltd. supplies precision components for semiconductor etching and thin film deposition equipment manufacturers in China. It offers process components, such as liner, heater, gas distribution plate and cavity, and other process components; and structural components, including cover plates, flange plates, signal boxes, and RF connection boards. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Jingjiang, China.
